reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was 30 foil sachets in a box, and my reaction was that it's a lot of packaging for 60 capsules I'd just dump into my weekly organizer anyway. The QR lab report is nice, but I'd rather pay for the magnesium than the wrapper.
objection: Individual foil packets are wasteful, and I already count capsules into a pill case, so I'm paying $30 for packaging I'd throw away. A bottle of bisglycinate costs much less per serving, and this brand has no reviews yet.
would_change_my_mind: A bottle or refill pouch at roughly $18 to $20 for 60 capsules with the same per-batch lab report, plus a few hundred real reviews.
